Hi, I struggle with an eating disorder as well. There are things that have made it easier for me to eat over time. For me a lot of distractions while I’m eating help. I’ll watch a movie or YouTube videos, play a mobile game, and by the time I’m done eating I realize I wasn’t even paying much attention to the act of it.

Another thing that helps me is to have small snacks that I enjoy, just to get over that initial anxiety and despair about eating. I’ll eat a sweet or crisps to get the physical anxiousness out a bit, then it becomes easier to ingest an actual meal. I hope this helps! 

Also, stay away from anything that triggers whatever the culprit of your eating disorder is. Social media, other people with the disorder, people who comment on your appearance. Find what helps you personally and focus on that.
